name: Stellar Vector
candidate_notes: University club at KU Leuven (Leuven, BE). Primarily-academic CTF team associated with KU Leuven; Discord is described as their main communication channel.

name: KalmarCTF
candidate_notes: University club at Danish/Nordic academic CTF collective (DTU-affiliated) (, DK). Collaborative of mostly Danish/Nordic academic CTF players (DTU and others), not a single university club, but the leading Nordic academic CTF community; Discord is for the KalmarCTF event/team.

name: Itemize NTNU
candidate_notes: University club at Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU) (Trondheim, NO). Norwegian CTF team out of NTNU Trondheim; Discord link found in the site footer.

name: CSeC, IIT Bombay
discord_description: Official server of the Cyber security Community (CSeC), IIT Bombay.
candidate_notes: University club at Indian Institute of Technology Bombay (Mumbai, IN). Also referenced as IITBreachers CTF team via csea-iitb.github.io wiki, which lists a different invite (discord.gg/eHGwP6CGSy) for what appears to be the same broader club; used the club's own current site (cseciitb.github.io) as primary.

name: Programming Club, IIT Kanpur
discord_description: We are a community of IIT Kanpur students highly enthusiastic about all aspects of programming.
candidate_notes: University club at Indian Institute of Technology Kanpur (Kanpur, IN). InfoSec is a track/team within the broader Programming Club, which runs a dedicated infosec roadmap (wiredin.pclub.in) and an infosec channel on this shared Discord; no separate infosec-only server was found.

name: SYNCS USYD
